title: From a lintegral area identity to the Bochner change of variables, with integrability
statement: Let μ, ν be measures on ℝ^P, φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, and J : ℝ^P → ℝ with J ≥ 0, such that ∫⁻ g dν = ∫⁻ J(x)·g(φ(x)) dμ(x) for every g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]. Let h, f : ℝ^P → ℝ, where h is ν-a.e. strongly measurable, f is μ-integrable, and J(x)·h(φ(x)) = f(x) for μ-a.e. x. Then h is ν-integrable and ∫ h dν = ∫ f dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (J h f : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ x, 0 ≤ J x) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y, g y ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (J x) * g (φ x) ∂μ) → AEStronglyMeasurable h ν → Integrable f μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, J x * h (φ x) = f x) → Integrable h ν ∧ ∫ y, h y ∂ν = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
